prompt: The video begins with a serene view of Castle Rock Beach in Meelup, Australia, where the camera smoothly pans across the pristine white sand meeting the calm, turquoise waters under a clear blue sky. The camera then moves forward along the shoreline, capturing the gentle waves lapping against the beach. As it progresses, the focus shifts to a large, rugged rock formation jutting out into the sea, its reddish-brown hues contrasting sharply with the surrounding greenery. The camera continues to move inland, revealing a dense cluster of trees and shrubs that line the beach. The perspective then elevates slightly, offering a broader view of the rocky terrain interspersed with patches of vegetation. The camera pans slowly, showcasing the intricate details of the rocks and the lush foliage. The sunlight bathes the entire scene in a warm glow, highlighting the vibrant colors of the landscape. As the camera continues its journey, it captures the natural beauty of the area, emphasizing the untouched and tranquil environment. The final frames show the camera moving deeper into the forested area, providing a closer look at the diverse plant life and the rugged terrain, all while maintaining a steady and immersive perspective throughout the sequence.
